type.notes: dist/index.html: fluid clamp scale; body >=16px via --fs-1; measure capped 65ch; Oswald display with -0.03em tracking and 0.92 line-height; DM Mono for gauge readings, sample tags, hours, phone, licence; tabular-nums on trust values; lead paragraph set apart; proper en-dashes in hour ranges and apostrophe in nor'easter. No orphans observable.

layout.notes: dist/index.html: 11 sections each with one job; alternating tones deep/paper/deep/mid/paper/deep/accent/paper/paper/paper/deep/paper; no two adjacent sections share layout family; full-bleed break; asymmetric spotlight; dense service grid followed by quiet ZIP checker. No blank gaps over half screen in CSS.

copy.notes: dist/index.html: voice matches concept sentences exactly; concrete trade nouns (heart pine, cupped boards, reclaimed slivers, vapor barrier, satin polyurethane); sample tags on rating, licence, pricing, reviews; consistent Price it action name; no banned words; no tricolons; buttons named for action; honest thank-you state in form.

mobile.notes: dist/index.html: hero media hidden below 900px; mobile bar fixed bottom with Call and Price-it, hidden at >=900px; tap targets >=48px; menu overlay with large links; flex-wrap on actions prevents horizontal scroll; form inputs min-height 48px; radio cards padded; breakpoints at 640 and 900 restructure grids. Reduced motion shows everything via .sw-motion gates.

a11y.notes: dist/index.html: skip link; focus-visible 3px solid var(--focus) offset 3px; forced-colors rules for controls; reduced-motion safety net kills animations; JS-off hides only JS-dependent controls; all inputs labeled; fieldset/legend on multi-step form; aria-live on ZIP result and age output; aria-expanded on menu button; aria-label on star ratings; heading order correct.

motion.notes: dist/index.html: >=3 hooks beyond reveals (split-text hero, pinned scroll story data-scroll-story=tide-rise, clip-path frames, counter-ready trust values); entrances vary by role; one hover language (ghost underline scaleX); no bounce easing; no layout property animations; Lenis loaded; reduced motion respected.

wow.notes: dist/index.html: tide-line gauge tied to thesis and trade; house-age guide outputs floor type and advice with handoff button prefilled with service; tool output uses signature vocabulary (DM Mono, tide reading). Signature moment and tool connected by measurement language.

polish.notes: dist/index.html: SVG favicon + apple-touch-icon; theme-color; OG image with dimensions; JSON-LD HomeAndConstructionBusiness; print stylesheet; lazy images with dimensions; hero preloaded; forced colors handled; consistent 2px radius; no shadows on non-floating; consistent icon stroke 2px; no transition:all.

elevate.move: Apply the type-mask treatment from the hero to at least one other section (e.g., mask CUPPING in water-damage with detail-cupping photo) so the signature extends into photography and earns the 10 anchor for art-directed stock usage.

Thread the tide-line gauge into the house-age guide output as a dynamic reading (e.g., LIKELY FLOOR 1.2 ft that updates with slider) so the signature does double duty as divider and tool output, making cover-the-logo test pass on any section.
